arabic text: AAYE JIS WAQT ASEERON ME WO TADFEEN KE BAAD
english translation text: WHEN THE PRISONERS RETURNED AFTER THE BURIALS,

arabic text: ROKE KARTE THE YAI AABIDE MUZTAR FARYAAD
english translation text: IMAM ZAINUL ABIDEEN CRIED OUT IN ANGUISH.

arabic text: AISI HAALAT ME THA LAASHA ABBAS KA,
english translation text: IN SUCH A STATE WAS THE BODY OF ABBAS,

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: DADI ZAHRA KI PAAMAL THI YU DUA
english translation text: AS IF THE PRAYERS OF GRANDMOTHER ZAHRA WERE TRAMPLED,

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: MAINE CHAHA KE MAYYAT KO YAKJAA RAHE
english translation text: I WISHED FOR THE BODY TO REMAIN WHOLE,

arabic text: APNE HAATHON SE BAAZU CHACHA KE CHUNE
english translation text: WITH MY OWN HANDS, I TRIED TO GATHER MY UNCLE’S ARMS.

arabic text: PATTHARON SE LAAENO NE MAARA UNHE
english translation text: THE ENEMIES STONED HIM,

arabic text: TUKDE TUKDE MUJE BAAZU UNKE MILE
english translation text: I FOUND ONLY FRAGMENTS OF HIS ARMS.

arabic text: EK BAAZU BHI UNKA SALAMAT NA THA
english translation text: NOT EVEN ONE OF HIS ARMS WAS INTACT.

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: CHAAR SU LAASH UNKI YU MUJKO MILI
english translation text: ALL AROUND ME I FOUND HIS SCATTERED BODY,

arabic text: JAISE MAYYAT THI QASIM KI BIKHRI HUI
english translation text: LIKE THE BROKEN BODY OF QASIM.

arabic text: BABAJAAN NE ABA ME USE CHUNLIYA
english translation text: MY FATHER GATHERED HIM IN HIS CLOAK,

arabic text: YE BHI MUMKIN NA THA HAAYE GURBAT MERI
english translation text: BUT FOR ME, IN MY HELPLESSNESS, EVEN THAT WAS NOT POSSIBLE.

arabic text: EK QAIDI THA MAI KAISE LAATA ABA
english translation text: I WAS A PRISONER — HOW COULD I HAVE BROUGHT THE CLOAK?

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: APNI HAALAT KARU KIS TARHA SE BAYAAN
english translation text: HOW CAN I DESCRIBE MY STATE?

arabic text: EK MANZAR PE MERI BANDHI HICHKIYA
english translation text: I WAS CHOKING ON SOBS AT THE SIGHT.

arabic text: PEHLUON PER YU NAIZO KE KUCH WAAR THE
english translation text: HIS RIBS WERE PIERCED WITH SPEARS,

arabic text: YAAD DADI KI AANE LAGI PASLIYA
english translation text: AND I REMEMBERED MY GRANDMOTHER’S BROKEN RIBS.

arabic text: YU SHIKASTA THA LAASHA SAMBHALTA NA THA
english translation text: SO SHATTERED WAS THE BODY, IT COULD NOT BE GATHERED.

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: DAAYEN JAANIB SE MAYYAT UTHAYI AGAR
english translation text: IF I LIFTED THE BODY FROM THE RIGHT,

arabic text: BAAYI JAANIB KIYA HADDIYON NE SAFAR
english translation text: THE BONES ON THE LEFT WOULD SCATTER.

arabic text: LAASH PAAMAL LASHKAR NE IS TARHA KI
english translation text: THE ARMY HAD TRAMPLED THE BODY SO MERCILESSLY,

arabic text: SHER KE TUKDE TUKDE HUI THI QAMAR
english translation text: THAT THE LION OF KARBALA, ABBAS, WAS IN PIECES.

arabic text: MERE KAANDHON PE LAASHA SAMBHAL NA SAKA
english translation text: EVEN UPON MY SHOULDERS, THE BODY COULD NOT BE BORNE.

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: RUN ME LADTE HUE ZEEN SE JAB GIRA
english translation text: WHEN HE FELL FIGHTING FROM HIS SADDLE,

arabic text: SAR JUDA TAN JUDA DONO BAAZU JUDA
english translation text: HIS HEAD SEVERED, HIS BODY SEVERED, HIS ARMS SEVERED.

arabic text: MERA BATTEES BARSO KA KADYAL JAWAAN
english translation text: MY THIRTY-TWO-YEAR-OLD BRAVE YOUTH,

arabic text: CHEH MAHINE KE ASGAR KE JITNA BACHA
english translation text: WAS REDUCED TO THE SIZE OF SIX-MONTH-OLD ASGHAR.

arabic text: USKO GHODO NE PAAMAL AISE KIYA
english translation text: THE HORSES TRAMPLED HIM SO FIERCELY,

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: TEER SE JIS GHADI RUN ME PAANI BAHA
english translation text: WHEN THE ARROW MADE WATER SPILL IN THE BATTLEFIELD,

arabic text: AISA LAGTA THA GHAZI KO AAYI QAZA
english translation text: IT FELT AS IF DEATH HAD COME TO GHAZI.

arabic text: MISLE GHAZI THA MASHKIZA ABBAS KA
english translation text: THE WATER SKIN OF ABBAS WAS LIKE ABBAS HIMSELF —

arabic text: NA WO KHAYME GAYA NA YE KHAYME GAYA
english translation text: NEITHER HE REACHED THE TENTS, NOR DID THE WATER.

arabic text: BAWAFA KA THA MASHKIZA BHI BAWAFA
english translation text: EVEN THE WATER SKIN OF THE LOYAL ONE REMAINED LOYAL.

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.

arabic text: QAAFELA LAUT KAR JAB MADINE GAYA
english translation text: WHEN THE CARAVAN RETURNED TO MADINAH,

arabic text: HAYE AKBAR YE UMMUL BANEEN NE KAHA
english translation text: ALAS, UMMUL BANEEN SAID:

arabic text: MERA ABBAS MAQTAL ME KAISE LADA
english translation text: 'HOW DID MY ABBAS FIGHT IN THE BATTLEFIELD?'

arabic text: BETA SAJJAD KYA HAAL LAASHE KA THA
english translation text: 'MY SON SAJJAD, WHAT WAS THE STATE OF HIS BODY?'

arabic text: ROKE SAJJAD BAS YE HI KEHTA RAHA
english translation text: SAJJAD WEPT AND COULD ONLY REPLY…

arabic text: MAI UTHATA RAHA WO BIKHARTA RAHA
english translation text: I LIFTED IT, BUT IT KEPT FALLING APART.
